english_outline.section1: Main conclusion: Samsung Q3 2026 operating profit KRW 107.4tn, first tech company above KRW 100tn; revenue KRW 195.3tn, up 14% QoQ; Reuters notes profit slightly beat LSEG SmartEstimate of KRW 106.1tn.
english_outline.section2: Core business change: DS Division drives results with KRW 147.1tn revenue and KRW 106.5tn operating profit; Memory sets record on AI product mix and HBM4 ramp; DX Division posts KRW 0.8tn operating loss; MX/NW combined KRW 0.6tn loss; VD/DA KRW 0.2tn loss.
english_outline.section3: Expectations: Memory demand to stay robust into 2027 on AI infrastructure capex; Q4 profit growth expected to slow to 8.2% QoQ from 20% in Q3; TrendForce sees conventional DRAM contract prices up 10-15% in Q4 vs 60% in Q2; capex 2026 at KRW 84.4tn.
english_outline.section4: Market pricing: Shares slipped 0.2% in early trade vs KOSPI down 0.5%; stock down over 25% from June record high; Mirae Asset analyst Kim Seok-hwan says focus shifted to sustainability; analysts trimmed forecasts on won appreciation.
english_outline.section5: Next quarter verification: Q4 memory price growth moderation, HBM4 shipment ramp, foundry utilization improvement, and shareholder return details at January 2027 board meeting.

reader_questions: 三星官方财报与路透社报道在移动业务亏损规模上是否存在口径差异？
路透社报道中关于代工业务亏损的表述，与三星官方对代工业务盈利改善的表述是否矛盾？
路透社报道的股价反应数据是否与官方财报发布日期一致？
checks: 官方财报显示MX与网络业务合计营业亏损0.6万亿韩元，路透社援引分析师称移动业务亏损超过10亿美元（约1.34万亿韩元），两者口径不同：官方为MX+网络合计，路透社为移动业务单独估算，且路透社数据来自分析师而非公司官方。
官方财报称代工业务营收和盈利显著改善，并计划四季度实现两位数营收增长和持续盈利改善；路透社援引分析师称代工业务预计将继续亏损。两者存在分歧，需在稿件中并列呈现。
路透社报道发布于10月8日，基于三星10月7日的初步业绩预告；官方详细财报发布于10月29日。路透社报道中的股价反应（早盘下跌0.2%）对应的是初步预告发布后的市场反应，而非详细财报发布后的反应。
